baseline.derivedFrom: pre-analysis fork + codebase reads during interview

claims.claim: UserService.registerHelmet() writes arrayUnion([id]) to users/{uid}.helmetIds with no verification
firestore.rules grants full read/write on helmets/{helmetId} to any uid with that id in helmetIds
docs/architecture/decisions.md and docs/architecture/receiver-protocol.md do not exist in the working tree or git history (docs/ was deleted in an earlier session revert)
functions/index.js authenticates /lora-uplink and /chirpstack-webhook with one shared X-Webhook-Token; firebase.json has no functions block (not a deployed Cloud Function)
firestore.rules contains an orphaned sites/{siteId} block with isSupervisor()/role checks unused by the current flat schema

qaLog.question: Primary goal of the (separate, dependent) data-flow simulator that motivated this spec.
Which injection path should the simulator use.
How should target-environment safety be handled (webhook writes to live smhelmet-67 Firestore, no dev/staging project exists).
qaLog.answer: User declined offered options and instead redirected: build a real pairing system first, make sure it works in a real-world scenario.

qaLog.question: Should the pairing system reuse the existing ADR-005 credential model or design fresh.
qaLog.answer: Adapt the existing ADR-005 model (Recommended) — later corrected by red team: ADR-005 does not exist, see D7.

qaLog.question: What physical thing should get credentialed/verified — Receivers only, Helmets only, or both.
How does a user prove they own a physical helmet when claiming it.
qaLog.answer: Pairing code / QR on the helmet (Recommended)

qaLog.question: Who provisions a new Receiver gateway, through what interface.
How should 'admin-only' actually be enforced given there's no role system (pushback: none exists today).
What should revocation cover (helmet unclaim, receiver revoke, both, or neither for now).
Should this spec replace the webhook's shared X-Webhook-Token with per-receiver credential auth.
Migration strategy for helmets/users under the OLD self-registration model on the LIVE deployment.

redTeamFindings.title: ADR-005/receiver-protocol.md do not exist in the repository
Old self-claim path not decided for removal
role field could be client-self-escalated via users/{uid} rule allowlist
redTeamFindings.resolution: Admin Cloud Function only, never client-writable (D6)

redTeamFindings.title: Webhook is a manually-run local process with a live admin key, not a deployed Cloud Function
redTeamFindings.resolution: Migrate to deployed Cloud Functions Gen2 (D10)

redTeamFindings.title: False 'no role system exists' premise — orphaned sites/ role hierarchy already in firestore.rules
redTeamFindings.resolution: Delete the orphaned sites/ rules block (D8)

redTeamFindings.title: No atomicity for claim operation (verify code / mark claimed / invalidate code)
redTeamFindings.resolution: Single Firestore transaction, explicit already-claimed error (D11)

redTeamFindings.title: No pairing-code entropy or rate-limiting spec
'Require re-claim for everyone' has no rollout/rollback plan for a live app
Wiping claims can strand unacknowledgeable alerts during transition
redTeamFindings.resolution: Admin retains blanket alert-ack rights during rollout (D14)

redTeamFindings.title: Per-uplink credential lookup adds a Firestore read with no caching decision
redTeamFindings.resolution: In-memory verifier cache, invalidated on revoke (D15)

redTeamFindings.title: No bootstrap path for the first admin account once role is locked down
